title: I BAN THEE
description: A mod that lets you send others away to never be seen again
body:
# _NOTICE:_
Further work on this mod is getting canned. Sorry if you wanted a bug fix or something important added.

# I BAN THEE
is a mod centered around the banishment of other players.

## Why though?
Sometimes in multiplayer servers, there is that one guy who some people just don't want nearby, since banning a player for their pressence is stupid, I made I BAN THEE.

## How to get started
I BAN THEE is an endgame mod, making the banishment staff is meant to be nearly impossible to keep servers fun and fair. [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)/[REI](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) will help you get the crafting materials if you don't know the recipe *(HINT: the dragon egg is at play here)*.

## Revenge?
not really, since I BAN THEE was made in my free time, this mod currently lacks an escape route. but don't worry, mods like [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones) can easily help you escape... if you have one.

# Problems?
let me know on [GitHub!](https://github.com/hecker2000/I-BANISH-THEE/issues)
